name: University of Helsinki
summary: Finland's oldest and largest university; two broad English bachelor's degrees in central Helsinki, and IB holders apply in March, not January.

ib.text: IB Diploma holders must apply in admission group 2 and are ranked on their IB grades. An IB taken in English proves your English; otherwise English A at grade 2 or English A2 at grade 5.

dates.label: Admission group 2 (IB Diploma holders) opens, 08:00 Finnish time
Admission group 2 (IB Diploma holders) closes, 15:00 Finnish time

notes: The January round (group 1, 5–19 January 2027) is only for applicants without an IB, EB or Finnish matriculation diploma, so as an IB student you cannot use it.
Helsinki's March round is separate from the national January joint application, so you can apply to both.
Liberal Arts and Sciences awards a BA, BSc or Bachelor of Social Sciences depending on the specialisation you choose.
